name: Finland
convention: Bank closure days per Suomen Pankki's official bank-holiday list: statutory holidays plus the non-statutory but bank-closed Midsummer Eve and Christmas Eve. Named holidays falling on a weekend are included (Suomen Pankki itself lists Dec 6 / Dec 26 regardless of weekday). Structurally-always-weekend holidays (Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday, Midsummer Day, All Saints' Saturday) are omitted here because the source omits them — see notes for how the calendar data file should treat them.

confidence.2025: reconstructed from the holiday rules (Easter 2025-04-20 anchor); Suomen Pankki no longer serves past years

notes: Midsummer Eve is the first Friday on or after June 19: 2025-06-20, 2026-06-19, 2027-06-25 (June 19 2027 is a Saturday, so the Eve moves to the 25th — the weekdayOnOrAfter rule at work).
2025-12-06 (Sat) and 2026-12-06 (Sun) are included: Independence Day is a holiday whichever day it falls on.

The v2 calendar data file may additionally encode the structurally-weekend holidays (Easter Sunday, Whit Sunday easterOffset +49, Midsummer Day = Eve + 1 via offsetFrom, All Saints weekdayOnOrAfter Oct 31 Saturday). They never affect working-day math under weekend [0,6] but keep the data file a complete statement of Finnish holidays; if encoded, this fixture's expected sets grow by those dates.
